reviews.text: You simply could not find a better group of professionals to take care of your animals!
Dr Sheila is always very professional. Describes things thoroughly. Very clear in what is wrong, the path forward.
LOVE the vets here and I feel completely confident they do the very best for my dog.
Love Del Mar Animal and Bird Hospital and Dr. Greenfield. His staff was so kind and friendly and his is so caring and thoughtful.
We really like the staff and veterinarians. My dog really doesn’t like people that much but he will happily walk off with any of the staff to get treatment. He loves them.

Not only do the Veternarians come with excellent reputations but as well they are pleasant, and informative with their patients and their owners.
The clinic is clean.
The staff is friendly.
I recommend this  Hospital to all my friends with dogs and cats.
Very nice docs and staff. They are very good and patient with my parrot, who can be a handful!

I have been taking my Frenchie and my Pug here for years! I am truly grateful for their love and concern for my pups! We’ve also followed Dr. Greenfield from his previous vet because we know that he treats our babies like his own!
The staff and Dr. Triggs were very kind and the service was given with care and loving to my doggy.

It's a pleasure bringing my cat here. I bring her once a month to get her teeth cleaned and claws trimmed.  All the techs are wonderful.  Especially Jenna!!! She is especially conscientious and "hangs in" to finish a great job despite my cat not always having patience.

We love Animal and Bird. Great animal hospital. We Have had several pets cared for by the veterinarians here, they are all excellent.

Dr Sheila Dietche is amazing, knowledgeable thorough and always kind. She has been taking great care of our new rescued flower.  Dr Dietche is a great listener, an excellent veterinarian and we are so grateful to have her guidance. She gives us excellent and thorough advice to help us give our dogs optimal happy healthy lives. Nit to mention I have taken my pets to her since 2004.

All the vets at Animal and Bird, who have treated our dogs are compassionate, thorough and interested in our pets health. Shout out to Dr Corey Greenfield!

Tony, Josh, Tyler,, Angela  are excellent vet techs and we value them as well, thank you all so much!.

I ask a lot of my vet each time I visits; I can happily say I feel heard and my pets health is valued at Animal and Bird. I have clear concise feedback, instructions as well as necessary follow up, just terrific knowledgeable doctors.

The front desk men and women  are professional, cheery, and ready to assist with any research or questions.
Great team work! Thank you A&B!
The Summers Clan
Dr. Ditsche is the best. She is caring and well knowledgeable and will not put your furry friend through unnecessary tests.

I was so impressed by the care and empathy towards all animals on my first visit. I took my parrot Tota for her first visit at Bird & Animal Hospital of Del Mar and now they have us forever. Thank you

Yes. This place is amazing. I came in a mess with my little baby dog who got clipped by a car. This is my usual vet, and in my panic I only thought of heading to them for what to do after this emergency. Even though they said that an emergency facility would be the move, the said we’re already here, we’ll get him stable, and make a game plan for next moves. Extremely professional, made us feel comfortable, the sense of urgency was palpable - it was very apparent how much this facility cares for these animals as well as their humans. They stayed well after their open hours to help us in our situation. They communicated with VEG in Encinitas, made a game plan, sent us there afterwards, sent the report and records - just made me feel like it was all going to be ok especially since they were so on it.

My little baby katsu came out on the other side all well.

Thank you so much for everything.

- Tyler and Katsu
Dr. Ditsche is the best!  She took care of my previous dog and cats and now my new puppy.  I totally trust her.  The other people in the office are great as well.  Very nice and helpful.
Very kind and knowledgeable! I have been going there for years with all my pets.

Whenever my dog needs care, she is always attended to right away. There is never a long wait.
This staff is very dedicated and has great compassion for their clients. They are thorough and very kind.

We have to go in now monthly for a shot for my chocolate lab. She gets very anxious  going to the vet. Dr Greenfield and his staff at ABH make it so simple and easy on her. They are super professional and friendly and my senior doggo always comes out smiling. We now take our 10 week old lab puppy and her first experience there was very successful.
10 out of 10 highly recommend  bring your pets up here. They will definitely take care of you!!
Friendly and efficient
Staff are very friendly and attentive. Dr Sheila Ditsche is always wonderful. Highly recommend A&B for any of your pet’s needs 🐶
Difficult parking, my girlfriend's dog was "scratched" in their boarding.

I felt that this team was very sincere and what I esp
Appreciated is that  they didn’t oversell me.  They truly care about your pet and will not prescribe procedures that are not absolutely necessary.  They care more about your pet than their pocket

What a disappointing experience I had trying to schedule an appointment with an avian vet for my bird, who hasn’t been feeling well.

When I called, the receptionist first placed me on hold. After returning, I explained my bird’s symptoms — he has been unusually quiet, puffed up, and having watery droppings for about two weeks. She then asked if I was a new client, and after I said yes, I was placed on hold again.

A while later, she returned and told me I should take my bird to an emergency vet. I asked why, since although he is not acting normally, he is still eating and moving around. She simply repeated that because I said he was not well, I needed to go to emergency care.

I explained that I was trying to schedule a regular appointment, not emergency treatment, so once again I was placed on hold. Eventually, the avian specialist came on the phone and informed me that if I wanted an appointment, I would need to pay $120 in advance for exams in order to secure it.

The entire interaction felt dismissive, confusing, and very impersonal. Instead of feeling supported or guided, I felt pressured and frustrated. I ultimately decided to take my bird somewhere else.

Wonderful experience this morning at Animal and Bird Hospital in Delmar. The staff is very friendly, professional and courteous and kind. The doctor was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. Did not push unnecessary exams or blood tests. I will be happy to recommend them to anyone that has pets who are part of the family🥰
Been taking care of our pets for many years and give the best care
Thank you for the review!

The staff is outstanding when handling both our dogs.  The care they take with both of  them is amazing.  The doctors listen and explain everything and always come up with a game plan regardless of what the issue is.    Shadow & Charlie appreciates them all!!

We always get great care, but honestly, the best part is that their hours are so convenient for getting appointments and they have enough vets that we rarely can’t get in within a day or two, sometimes the same day is even possible.  Every vet and vet tech I’ve seen there has been capable and kind.  They have provided great advice to me over the phone or email while we’ve had a vet need while traveling. So happy we moved our dog to this practice.

I have been taking my pets to Animal and Bird Hospital for a number of years now, and have had wonderful service from them.  Dr Fournier is my veterinarian and she is both knowledgeable and caring which I so appreciate. I highly recommend this practice to anyone.
Thank you for the kind review!
Thank you for the review!

I've been coming here since I moved here in 2022. Every person there is incredibly kind, caring, and friendly. They have cared for 3 of my pets. My senior cat in her last year. Then my fospice cat. And now my first dog. They have been there for me and my companions during our most difficult times. The care is top tier. Highly recommend.
Thank you for the review!
Clean. All Vets are very knowledgeable & caring.😻😻

For starters, the girls at the front desk quick, professional, and a pleasure to chat with. Not much of a wait-time. I saw Dr. Kyra Littel for the first annual check-up for Dax. She is a great addition to the team. I like that they are not owned by privet equity; that's a plus.

Animal and Bird Hospital is fabulous.  Dr. Triggs will always have a special place in our hearts since she was so compassionate when our English Bulldog had cancer.  She took all the time we needed and answered all questions.  We could don't have asked for more.  Dr. Ditsche also saw our boys and is also aa great vet.  The staff makes you feel so welcome and care are very accommodating to questions.
Thank you for the review!

Just got my dog neutered here.
They did a phenomenal job!
Dr Fournier is very professional, knowledgeable, and empathetic.
As usual, the best of care for my Gino. The front office girls are always so cheerful and helpful. I’m so grateful for all of the excellent care my pets receive.
Dr. Fournier's care and concern for my animals is above and beyond great. She is so knowledgable and caring.

My experience was beyond expectation. The doctor was very knowledgeable and she Took the time In decision-making regarding my pets upper respiratory infection, which made me feel very comfortable . The entire staff was very friendly, Knowledgeable And caring . I have found A special place

Kudos to Dr. Greenfield and the wonderful staff at Animal & Bird Hospital. They do a great job of treating and supporting animals in their care. I have no reservations in recommending them to care for your pet. We really appreciate Dr. Greenfield’s straightforward and practical approach to pet care. He’s never trying to sell you on the latest thing, only treatments or meds that make sense for your pet.
My Zoe (4 year old mixed breed pup) LOVES coming to see her friends at Animal & Bird!    I love knowing that she's always getting excellent care.

This place deserves a steller 5 STAR!  Every single time, every vet here is awesome & steller!

We had an emergency need today and couldn't believe they were open on a Sunday too when we called (thinking we'd be leaving them a message)!  What other vet is open on a Sunday besides an emergency vet?!

Love ALL the staff-knowledgeable, professional, kind, caring & nice!

The tech before the vet came in, asked really good questions to help understand the issue.

Loved that Dr. Greenfield got down on the floor to greet our little boy AND remembered what he treated him last for over 1/2 a year ago.  Asking update questions.

Both natural help & medical from their vets.  Only took seconds for Dr. Greenfield to figure out what caused our little boy Cashew's issue by asking us the perfect questions and info that triggered us to give the issue's answer.  He gave us a natural suppliment to help that they had there.  Once home, our little boy is regular again and feeling so much better.

The BEST vet clinic ever!  Seriously!  We've had so many bad, thank God we found this place and Dr. Sheila again too!

I had a wonderful experience with the animal hospital!  I was there for the first time with my puppy and we had made an appt for A Monday but when I realized he needed to be seen, they moved up my appointment even though he was a new patient. The veterinarian, Dr Littel, Erin, and the whole staff made me feel welcome and spent a good amount of time with us. There was no upselling, just great care.  I am so grateful that I found this wonderful clinic!!!  Highly Recommend
Love this place--everyone there is so amazing that I am afraid to let others know because I may not be able to book appointments!

You know how hard it is to find a good avian veterinarian? Well, look no further -- go see Dr. Greenfield! He treated my little parakeet like she was his most important patient for the day.  :-)  He's knowledgeable, patient, and thorough -- and the staff are super nice, too.  I'm so glad we came to see him.
Dr. Greenfield is the most thoughtful and caring Vet we have ever had! He loves my 2 dogs and cares for them and about them as if they were their own. I couldn’t recommend him enough. 10/10!
Just AMAZING! Dr. Sheila from the Animal Bird Hospital has overseen the care of two of our dogs over the years and continue to provide the best knowledge and service for our dogs and family.

I've been taking my dogs and cats to the Animal and Bird Hospital for 20 years, and I am so grateful that I live near this vet office. Every single person I've  interacted with at this establishment has been truly kind, helpful, and excellent at their job. I've been blown away at how doctors, vet techs, and all employees have gone above and beyond to make sure my animals were taken care of well. The care of Doctors Triggs, Greenfield, Ditsche, and Mira helped my dog live a long healthy life to 17.5. I know I'm lucky, but also I can't help but attribute her excelent health to the Animal & Bird Hospital of Del Mar. Thank you, Animal & Bird Hospital for all you do, for all the animals and all the people that you help every day, for staying calm in a crisis, for never pressuring anyone to get treatments, for being insanely knowledgeable and all together wonderful people.

If you go to this vet, you're one of the lucky ones.

This is the best rec, Ive ever gotten, for our cats. We take in rescues. Our most recent had a lot of problems, prob from being in foster group/suffering malnutrition.spent thousands, and driving t a Holistic vet in Vista. We live on he border SD,and Del Mar client,(am HHP f people) referred this Vet.Have had a few diff ones attend kitty. They are reasonably priced,Don't try t upsell tyou, with a lot of exp. testing, without giving the simplest treatment, chance 1st. Our poor scaredy cat rescue, loves theses, guys. And They fixed her problems quickly/completely, every  time. They also trim  nails f us, at low cost. We went around getting consults at a few popular local Animal/Cat Vets.When We first had problems with our latest rescues. The prices,just f a consult made my hair stand up.The Vets
/Staff here ,fantastic!

I had the opportunity to complete my clinical hours for school at this clinic, and just wow.
I truly could not have had a better experience and been around a better group of staff.
All of their staff are so insanely knowledgeable and their level of care is truly unmatched.
I’ve watched them through puppy vaccine exams to unexpected emergencies and with every single one they were on top of everything and providing the best care possible.
I can promise you that when your baby is in their care, they are safe and loved, they treat every animal & every species as if they were their own pets.
Genuinely such an amazing clinic & I cannot recommend them enough!!🫶🏼

I have 2 cats, 2 pet dogs and I raise service dog puppies.  All the vets in the practice are excellent (my animals primarily see Dr. Fournier.  My actual first experience with them was during an emergency with one of my cats at their previous practice.  They were able to see me right away, help calm my fears and took amazing care of my cat's bladder obstruction.  When they moved their practice to this location I did not hesitate to follow them.  They continually take amazing care of my animals, and me, as the often nervous and overly cautious pet parent.  All of the staff at the practice are just so friendly and helpful.  You can really tell that they are there because they love animals and are going to take great care of your furry and feathered loved ones.  Getting an appointment is really easy, especially now that they have Sunday hours.  All my pets and  my service dog pups in training say that you can't go wrong with using Animal & Bird Hospital!!

I love taking my dog to the Animal and Bird Hospital of Del Mar.
The folks who work there are super friendly, very caring, and knowledgeable about your pet.  My dog is treated with love and he so  enjoys that attention
Skilled , caring, kind and listens to the pet parent.

We have been only in Solana Beach for a year now and Animal & Bird was referred to us by a friend.  We have 2 dogs, a boxer and a great dane Mix.  Cedar our boxer has been to Animal & Bird a few times as she has allergies to I swear everything in California and every time we go there they make her very comfortable and always explains everything going on. Ruby our great dane mix usually hates vets and has to be sedated to take the edge off.  Well Layne the first day she meet Ruby got on the floor and made Ruby feel at home and very comfortable and not stressed.  Layne is the only vet Ruby will see as we dont need to sedate her if she is seeing Layne.  The staff at Animal & Bird are awesome and always makes you feel at home and comfortable and know your animal is in great hands.

Scott Newell

My10yr old Yorkshire Terrier rescued me & she is a precious family member. I trust & am fully confident in her health care team at A&BH. Look no further for your pet’s healthcare needs.
THANK YOU SO MUCH Dr. Littel & A&BH Team!!
Dr. Dietche was very thorough with Elvis as she always is. A 10 thanking you so much  ❤️
Great care for my pets.    From boarding to grooming.  Nice people here.

The Animal And Bird Hospital of Del Mar is a FABULOUS CARING group of highly trained professionals. The level of care and attention to detail by the AMAZING Veterinary staff is so reassuring for my family. Our dogs are just as important to us as our kids ❤️. We strive to provide the best care possible for our fur babies .This group provides us with so much insight and knowledge about our pets health and mental well-being.
I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.
Barbara Fusco

I am so glad I asked a friend for a vet referral for my first pup. I wanted someone trustworthy as this would be my first experience on my own with a pet. Thankfully she recommended Del Mar Bird & Animal Hospital and even drives down from Orange County and said she trusts them with every decision. We made an appointment and see Dr. Dietsche who is very kind and caring and understanding and gives helpful explanations and timelines to a new helicopter pet parent like myself. She also gave me a great recommendation for a trainer we could not be happier with! Everybody we have come  in contact with at the front desk, techs and assistants are all kind and welcoming and very sweet. Would highly recommend and will continue our care here!

I have been seeing all of the veterinarians at Animal & Bird Hospital of Del Mar for 12 years. They are the most caring and knowledgeable professionals you may find. I wouldn't trust my babies to anyone else!
Been bringing my pets here for 14 years now. Great service and email friendly.

Love this veterinary clinic! I had  to keep changing vet clinics because no one would work on my cat.
Finally a vet who can, thank goodness. I have a big, beautiful Ragdoll cat who grumbles and growls to appear like a mean guy but he’s all talk. I have been to 3 different vet clinics who end up not being able to do anything with him. It’s been very frustrating until I had an appointment with Dr. Littel who did amazing with Leo. She was gentle but persistent.
They are a kind, honest and thorough vet clinic.  If you are like me and feel like you’re always being talked into paying for multiple tests and medication for your pets then bring your animals here. It didn’t happen at Animal & Bird Hospital of Del Mar.
They will discuss possible options and pricing but not make you feel persuaded or even guilted into opting for all treatments, tests and meds. The prices are more reasonable than many clinics too.
The front staff is very friendly, the vet techs are wonderful and the vets themselves are incredible!
It’s nice to finally feel like I have a home vet that  really cares about my furry family.

Always really kind and genuine to my pug.  Questions are always answered and you aren't left wondering why i was charged for something.   Dr. Littel has looked out for my girl for awhile and really cares about her.   5 stars!

I have a parakeet that apparently has too much keratin in his system and has to have his beak trimmed every two months, and they did a great job today like always! They handled the bird with care and efficient in time, and I was in and out in less than 15 minutes. I have been going to the Animal and Bird Hospital since 2004 and I’ve always had a great experience with them.
This is the best, best vet.  Everything from the quality of ALL of the vets, the helpful and pleasant staff, and the true caring for your pets!
We love Animal and bird hospital of Del Mar, they are truly professional and caring. Front staff is also wonderful. We couldn’t be happier. Thank you!!!
Dr. Sheila and Dr. Greenfield ARE THE BEST - we love them!!!!!” ALL the staff there is so caring, so full of knowledge, both holistic and normal vet medical.  Best vets we've EVER had!!!
Worked us in last minute on a weekend.  Dr was very thorough and kind. Staff is always very helpful and friendly.

Been to many vets over the years and this is at the top of the list.  Brought my puppy in for initial visit and the experience was top notch.  The staff were incredibly friendly and the veterinarian spent as much time as I needed to answer questions and was genuinely interested in the health of my dog.  I was super impressed!
Thank you for the review!

I bring my 35 yr old female Goffins Cockatoo to this facility for medical and grooming. I have been here since the originator- dr Stonebreaker. Great staff, kind, respectful and knowledgeable. I highly recommend them for all pets. I see how they show friendliness and calm to the "parents" as they bring in their furbabies for treatments. Well respected in this area for sure.
Over twenty years taking care of our pets, Animal & Bird is caring, friendly, professional and always willing to go the extra mile.  Highly recommend.
Excellent service. All the employees really care about my dog Ruth I’ve been going there for 30 years and recommended to everybody I know.

Sometimes, our 4 legged friends have a sudden health issue that makes us concerned about their comfort.   I love that I can call Animal and Bird Hospital of Del Mar and get a same day or next day appt.
Our dog, Hershey has had the pleasure of seeing all of the vets there and is in perfect health because of them.  This is the 4th dog we’ve owned since 1998 that we’ve trusted to their care.  All is well!
As always, they provided excellent care for our dog.   Appreciated the next day telephone follow up.

It’s getting more difficult to find a vet that can trim a parakeet’s nails.  Vets specializing in birds are far and few between.  This was a pleasant experience as both the vet and the technician were very personable, gentle and professional with my sweet Luna bird.  Thank you for your kindness to both bird and her human care taker.

I have been bringing my dog Ollie to A&B since he was 6 months old. It has honestly been the best decision I have made. A&B has become a second home for Ollie for both daycare and veterinary services.

Best vet. They treat your pets like their own.  I drive all the way from downtown to bring my pets to see them.  When my dog needed a specialist, the vets here found us the absolute best. We could not be move grateful to you all! Thank you Animal and Bird for all that you do.  Love Squid, Ruth, Kaila, and Joe.

This is an excellent choice for our dogs.  Their service and caring are above reproach.  Thank you for taking such good care of them.
Sheila Sayles

We had a great experience at Animal & Bird Hospital of Del Mar. My Umbrella Cockatoo went to stay for boarding and grooming and loved it. The vet and staff were so attentive and caring. Will definitely come back for boarding.

My little dog had  her teeth removed surgical. The entire staff were educated, compassionate and professional. At discharge, the vet took the time to talk thru the orders and answer all our questions.
The discharge write up went thru the surgery step by step along with nail trimming for free since it was needed at the time and ideal timing. WOW!
They even followed up to ensure my little dog was on the mend.

We have been at Animal & Bird Hospital for years...They always go the extra mile....Thank you for taking care of our fur baby with tender loving care!

I’ve had the pleasure of bringing my two cats to Dr. Ditsche and the team at Animal & Bird Hospital of Del Mar over the past two years, and I can confidently say that my experience has been outstanding. Dr. Ditsche is incredibly knowledgeable and skilled, but what truly sets her apart is her holistic and ethical approach to veterinary care, which I find to be rare in the field. Having moved frequently and seen numerous vets over the years, I can honestly say that Dr. Ditsche is the best I’ve encountered. I've brought my cats in for everything from annuals to sick visits to dental cleanings. Her compassion, expertise, and commitment to the well-being of my two boys have given me peace of mind, and I’m so grateful to have found such an exceptional vet. All of the staff and techs have been absolutely wonderful with each visit and are the best I've experienced as well. Highly recommend!

Dr Littel and team brought another level of care and kindness that’s not too common in the veterinary space. They took the time to answer all of my questions about how to properly care for my recent rescue. And the vet techs were just as engaging and eager to help.

Dr. Greenfield is by far the best vet I have ever had for my pups. He is honest and takes the time to educate me on what is going on with my animals. He is a wealth of knowledge and I trust him with the wellbeing of my animals. I highly recommend!
The Best Care ever!!!! always there to Help

They were very good with my not so easy for the vet cat and made him super comfortable  and happy. They didn't try to charge me a fortune for unnecessary tests like other vets did in the past.  They were kind and caring and reasonable and took great care of both of my ragdoll cats. One had a lump I was afraid might be cancer but it turned out to be nothing, whew!  Such a relief.  My other cat is a senior with FIV. They really spent a lot of time making sure my cats and I were happy, and we were ❤️🙏😊

The staff is outstanding! Educated, luving to my two(1older) sweet luv birds. Vet. Doc really on the ball w lots of questions, how to feed older, what do I need attitude. The staff cared for my birds so well I could see in the pics. Safest place to board your luv’d ones. Scale 1-10, I give Animal & Bird Hospital a 12!🫶 …

Our Aussie, Ruby was approaching end of life Drs Marley and Cory consulted with us and gave us the best advice.  Unfortunately we had to put Ruby down tonight. They were able to give us the best last two days of her life and referred us to the best service to take care of her at the end.  Thank you so much for everything.
Highly recommend this hospital. Dr. Kyra Littel has a wonderful, caring personally. She really listened to my concerns.
I have been coming here for years with my bird and my terrier. They are very accommodating with my busy schedule, and are always kind.

I recently took my two dogs to Animal & Bird Hospital for the first time, and we had a fantastic experience. From the warm welcome at the front desk to the attentive nurse who assisted us, and especially Dr. Ditsche, everyone made us feel at ease. My dogs were comfortable and happy throughout the visit, and I truly enjoyed meeting the entire team. Highly recommended!

What I really liked about this, Office is the doctor gave me an estimation before providing any services. She also made reasonable recommendations on what could wait or wasn’t real necessary just wanted to give you the option. I made the option to be conservative, I was still treated respectfully and not judged

The services were provided timely as well as the office appointment time

The staff were all very nice to my pets and even helped me out to my car with a heavy travel carrier and my 18 pound kitty.

The office as well as the exam room were very clean and had distractions for the pet.

I will return for future visits

There are not enough superlatives to express my love for the Animal and Bird Hospital. In terms of professionalism, responsiveness, quality of care, and compassion for animals (and humans, too!), they are the best there is. To a person, …
The BEST most caring doctors, technicians and assistants ever! Highly recommended!

Over the past 35 years my 5 German Shepards have been cared for by your facility. Recently my 13 year old Shepard was in discomfort and you quickly had us come into the faculty and eased his (and my) discomfort.  Thank you
Been going to Animal & Bird Hospital in Del Mar for 20+ years and we've always been given the best care. Highly recommend!
